phase.title: Composer intelligence
phase.goal: Make the Dr. Stein menu composer behave like an intelligent command surface: predictive slash commands, explainable recommendations, keyboard navigation, and tests for common typo/partial-command gaps.

phase.title: Efficient Training Pipeline
phase.goal: Complete the 3-stage training pipeline (SFT → Reasoning → DPO) with memory-efficient techniques: bfloat16 autocast, gc.collect graph cleanup, gradient checkpointing. Fix the Stage 2 memory leak, re-run reasoning training, run DPO to produce dr_stein.pt.

phase.title: Eval & Continual Improvement
phase.goal: Establish dr_stein baseline, build benchmark battery (HumanEval/MBPP/GSM8K/ARC/HellaSwag/GAD-tool-calls), wire OpenCode free-tier teacher distillation, stand up a training factory that sweeps configs across many small experiments fast.
